#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class IntIntPair {
public:
    int first;
    int second;
    IntIntPair(int f, int s) : first(f), second(s) {}
    bool operator<(const IntIntPair& o) const {
        if (first != o.first) return first < o.first;
        return second < o.second;
    }
};

class TaskC {
private:
    static const int BAD = 11111;
    int rows;
    int cols;
    vector<map<IntIntPair, int>> mem;

    bool contains(int mem, int index) {
        if (index < 0) return false;
        return ((mem >> index) & 1) == 1;
    }

    int add(int mem, int index) {
        if (((mem >> index) & 1) == 0) {
            mem += (1 << index);
        }
        return mem;
    }

    int size(int mem) {
        int res = 0;
        while (mem > 0) {
            if (mem % 2 == 1) res++;
            mem /= 2;
        }
        return res;
    }

    void test() {
        if (contains(5, 0) == false) throw runtime_error("");
        if (contains(5, 1) == true) throw runtime_error("");
        if (contains(5, -1) == true) throw runtime_error("");
        if (contains(5, 2) == false) throw runtime_error("");
        if (contains(5, 3) == true) throw runtime_error("");
        if (add(0, 2) != 4) throw runtime_error("");
        if (add(4, 0) != 5) throw runtime_error("");
        if (add(5, 0) != 5) throw runtime_error("");
        if (size(5) != 2) throw runtime_error("");
    }

    int dp(int row, int remabove, int squareabove) {
        if (row == rows) {
            if (remabove == 0) return 0;
            return BAD;
        }
        auto it = mem[row].find(IntIntPair(remabove, squareabove));
        if (it != mem[row].end()) return it->second;
        int res = BAD;
        int possibilities = 1 << cols;
        for (int poss = 0; poss < possibilities; poss++) {
            int have = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                if (((poss >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    have += 1 << j;
                }
            }
            bool works = true;
            for (int above = 0; above < cols; above++) {
                if (((remabove >> above) & 1) == 1) {
                    if (((have >> above) & 1) == 0) {
                        works = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (works) {
                int remhere = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    if (!contains(have, j - 1) && !contains(have, j) && !contains(have, j + 1) && !contains(squareabove, j)) {
                        remhere = add(remhere, j);
                    }
                }
                res = min(res, size(have) + dp(row + 1, remhere, have));
            }
        }
        mem[row][IntIntPair(remabove, squareabove)] = res;
        return res;
    }

public:
    void solve() {
        test();
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        cols = min(n, m);
        rows = max(n, m);
        mem.resize(rows);
        int res = dp(0, 0, 0);
        cout << (cols * rows - res) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
